verdict.rationale: Sardine documents its own Case Management workspace, but the evidence pack never shows investigations or decisions being synchronized with an external case-management system. The Middesk 'Bidirectional Dashboard & API Sync' covers business-verification data, not case or investigation sync, so it does not count toward this story. The KYB async webhooks are likewise limited to business verification updates.

support.subject: As a developer, I can synchronize investigations and decisions with another case-management system
